column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 12 (M23012): pasokan menipis, Brigadir Jenderal berangkat ke garis depan.
# Tetap Inggris: Mokosh, Wildhunt, Welrod, Vasily, Poludnitsa, George, Mica Port, Cliffwatch,
# Turul, Great Wall Railway, 11th Bureau, Mangi Security, Monsoon Squad, Oathguards,
# Doll, Frame, P.M.C., URNC, DEFY, Statesec, Yellow Zone, Commodore.
(Countless charred limbs and wreckage piled up on the land pitted by artillery fire.)
column2: (Anggota tubuh hangus dan puing tak terhitung menumpuk di tanah yang bopeng oleh tembakan artileri.)

column1: (Even through the screen, it was as if one could smell the scorching and pungent odor of the battlefield.)
column2: (Bahkan lewat layar, seolah tercium bau gosong dan menyengat khas medan tempur.)

column1: Commander, we... can be considered to have temporarily overcome this difficulty, right.
column2: Komandan, kita... bisa dibilang untuk sementara sudah melewati kesulitan ini, kan.

column1: Yes, at least for a short time, this elite force cannot launch an attack of the same scale again.
column2: Ya, setidaknya untuk waktu dekat, pasukan elite ini tidak bisa melancarkan serangan berskala sama lagi.

column1: (Thanks to the cooperative combat of the Dolls and the guard troops, although the assault from the Wildhunt briefly broke through the defense line and caused some damage to the Dolls, it did not deal a devastating blow to Mokosh's defense.)
column2: (Berkat pertempuran bersama para Doll dan pasukan penjaga, meski serbuan Wildhunt sempat menembus garis pertahanan dan melukai beberapa Doll, itu tidak memberi pukulan telak pada pertahanan Mokosh.)

column1: (At this moment, in that ruin covered with scars, the Doll squads gradually converged, assisting the Oathguards to rest and transfer, forming a bright color amidst the scorched black.)
column2: (Saat ini, di reruntuhan yang penuh luka itu, regu-regu Doll perlahan berkumpul, membantu Oathguards beristirahat dan berpindah, membentuk warna cerah di tengah hitam yang hangus.)

column1: Commander, you can rest assured.
column2: Komandan, Anda boleh tenang.

column1: Sir, Monsoon Squad has finished resting. There are no abnormalities with our frames, and we are ready to continue combat operations.
column2: Pak, Monsoon Squad selesai beristirahat. Tidak ada kelainan pada frame kami, dan kami siap melanjutkan operasi tempur.

column1: (As if noticing the gaze from the other side of the reconnaissance drone, Welrod, who had just arrived to assist, leaned out of the car window and waved at me. The other resting Dolls beside her also gestured toward the camera one after another.)
column2: (Seolah menyadari tatapan dari balik drone pengintai, Welrod yang baru tiba untuk membantu menjulurkan badan dari jendela mobil dan melambai padaku. Para Doll lain yang sedang beristirahat di sebelahnya juga bergantian memberi isyarat ke kamera.)

column1: Good work, everyone.
column2: Kerja bagus, semuanya.

column1: (I watched the screen, watching the Dolls in different positions on the battlefield, separated by screens—)
column2: (Kutatap layar, menatap para Doll di berbagai posisi di medan tempur, terpisah oleh layar—)

column1: Just now, everyone successfully resisted the invading strong enemy.
column2: Barusan, kalian semua berhasil menahan musuh kuat yang menyerbu.

column1: But, our enemies will not stop, nor will they yield. They may dispatch stronger fire support, they may cut off our supplies, they may turn their targets to neighboring settlements, leaving us surrounded by enemies and with no time to respond.
column2: Tapi musuh kita tidak akan berhenti, tidak pula akan mengalah. Mereka mungkin mengirim dukungan tembakan yang lebih kuat, mungkin memutus pasokan kita, mungkin mengalihkan sasaran ke permukiman tetangga, sehingga kita dikepung musuh dan tak sempat merespons.

column1: This is a continuous war of attrition, the real challenge has just begun.
column2: Ini perang gesekan yang berkelanjutan, tantangan yang sebenarnya baru saja dimulai.

column1: So, I ask everyone to be sure to stay calm, stay vigilant, and also maintain necessary rest.
column2: Karena itu, aku minta kalian semua tetap tenang, tetap waspada, dan tetap beristirahat secukupnya.

column1: Before the next fierce battle arrives, we must all maintain this defense line well.
column2: Sebelum pertempuran sengit berikutnya datang, kita semua harus menjaga garis pertahanan ini baik-baik.

column1: Commander, this is the latest material consumption report.
column2: Komandan, ini laporan konsumsi material terbaru.

column1: (After dealing with several rounds of surprise attacks and arranging the actions of the Dolls and the Oathguards, Vasily and I immediately started a discussion meeting regarding various combat materials.)
column2: (Setelah menangani beberapa gelombang serangan mendadak dan mengatur gerak para Doll serta Oathguards, aku dan Vasily langsung menggelar rapat pembahasan berbagai material tempur.)

column1: (Compared to the hail of bullets on the battlefield, the invisible slaughter off the battlefield is equally brutal.)
column2: (Dibanding hujan peluru di medan tempur, pembantaian tak kasatmata di luar medan tempur sama brutalnya.)

column1: (--Since Mokosh officially went to war with the consortium, several supply transport routes to neighboring settlements have been cut off. Although food, ammunition, medical supplies, and other materials were hoarded in large quantities before the war, they are continuously consumed as the fighting persists, leading to a lack of resupply.)
column2: (--Sejak Mokosh resmi berperang dengan konsorsium, beberapa jalur pengangkutan pasokan ke permukiman tetangga terputus. Meski pangan, amunisi, perbekalan medis, dan material lain ditimbun besar-besaran sebelum perang, semuanya terus terkuras selama pertempuran berlanjut, sehingga pasokan ulang tersendat.)

column1: (In fact, not only Mokosh, but the various settlements that once established cooperation with Mokosh are also facing the same crisis.)
column2: (Sebenarnya bukan cuma Mokosh, berbagai permukiman yang dulu menjalin kerja sama dengan Mokosh juga menghadapi krisis yang sama.)

column1: (Mica Port was occupied from the very beginning, Cliffwatch is struggling to hold on, and the settlements neighboring Mokosh are constantly shrinking their front lines due to a shortage of supplies and combat power. Only Turul, due to the presence of the Great Wall Railway garrison, still maintains a neutral state and has not been engulfed by the flames of war.)
column2: (Mica Port diduduki sejak awal, Cliffwatch sekuat tenaga bertahan, dan permukiman-permukiman tetangga Mokosh terus menyusutkan garis depannya karena kekurangan pasokan dan daya tempur. Hanya Turul yang, berkat adanya garnisun Great Wall Railway, masih menjaga status netral dan belum ditelan kobaran perang.)

column1: (Although the war has just begun, if this situation continues, it will be extremely detrimental to the entire resistance front.)
column2: (Meski perang baru saja dimulai, kalau keadaan ini berlanjut, itu akan sangat merugikan seluruh front perlawanan.)

column1: ...The consumption of supplies is more severe than imagined.
column2: ...Pemakaian pasokan lebih parah dari bayangan.

column1: (Mokosh right now cannot afford to waste even a single bit of supplies.)
column2: (Mokosh saat ini tidak boleh membuang pasokan sedikit pun.)

column1: (Although I've already discussed the supply of materials during the battle with Poludnitsa, with the main entry and exit routes blockaded by the financial conglomerate, we must find a safer, more covert method of transportation for subsequent supplies to truly alleviate our worries.)
column2: (Meski aku sudah membahas pasokan material selama pertempuran dengan Poludnitsa, dengan jalur keluar-masuk utama diblokade konglomerat keuangan, kami harus menemukan cara pengangkutan yang lebih aman dan tersembunyi untuk pasokan berikutnya agar kekhawatiran kami benar-benar berkurang.)

column1: When the 11th Bureau first came to aid in Mokosh's construction, they built a water channel that connected to the natural underground waterways in the outer mountains.
column2: Waktu 11th Bureau pertama kali datang membantu pembangunan Mokosh, mereka membuat saluran air yang tersambung ke saluran bawah tanah alami di pegunungan luar.

column1: When we were going against George, we even used it to transfer personnel.
column2: Waktu kami melawan George, kami bahkan memakainya untuk memindahkan orang.

column1: We specifically scouted it this time as well. Because of years of disrepair, many parts are unsafe, so it was sealed.
column2: Kali ini kami juga sudah mengintainya secara khusus. Karena bertahun-tahun tidak terawat, banyak bagian yang tidak aman, jadi ditutup.

column1: Vasily, I will dispatch Doll squads to assist you. We must clear those routes as soon as possible, the more the better!
column2: Vasily, aku akan mengirim regu Doll untuk membantumu. Kita harus membuka jalur-jalur itu secepatnya, makin banyak makin baik!

column1: These transport passages... can not only become supply lines for materials, but also supply lines for future combat power!
column2: Lorong-lorong angkut itu... bukan cuma bisa jadi jalur pasokan material, tapi juga jalur pasokan daya tempur di masa depan!

column1: Okay! I'll go arrange it right away.
column2: Baik! Saya akan langsung mengaturnya.

column1: Mhm, pay attention to acting secretly, only pick the most reliable people to do it.
column2: Mhm, bergeraklah diam-diam, pilih hanya orang-orang yang paling bisa dipercaya.

column1: I will also contact Poludnitsa in advance. Once the clearance is successful, we will proceed with supply docking.
column2: Aku juga akan menghubungi Poludnitsa lebih dulu. Begitu pembukaannya berhasil, kita lanjutkan penyambungan pasokan.

column1: (Vasily nodded and left hurriedly.)
column2: (Vasily mengangguk dan bergegas pergi.)

column1: (Watching his figure disappear in the corridor, I turned my gaze back to the sand table and screen again.)
column2: (Menatap sosoknya lenyap di koridor, kualihkan lagi pandanganku ke meja pasir dan layar.)

column1: (In the wilderness, in the trenches, the Doll squads and the Oathguards enjoyed a brief and precious time of rest.)
column2: (Di padang tandus, di parit-parit, regu Doll dan Oathguards menikmati waktu istirahat yang singkat dan berharga.)

column1: (On the sand table, the targets marked in red were stationary, yet seemed restless, brewing their next surprise attack.)
column2: (Di meja pasir, sasaran-sasaran bertanda merah itu diam, tapi terasa gelisah, sedang meracik serangan mendadak berikutnya.)

column1: (No one knew when the next attack would come, nor did anyone know what kind of battle situation would greet them when the sun rose tomorrow.)
column2: (Tak ada yang tahu kapan serangan berikutnya datang, tak ada pula yang tahu situasi tempur seperti apa yang menyambut mereka saat matahari terbit besok.)

column1: (But I will do my best to let Mokosh hold on a little longer, and even longer, in every future impact.)
column2: (Tapi aku akan berusaha sekuat tenaga agar Mokosh bisa bertahan sedikit lebih lama, dan lebih lama lagi, di setiap hantaman yang akan datang.)

column1: Commodore, this is the latest combat report from the Mokosh front line.
column2: Komodor, ini laporan tempur terbaru dari garis depan Mokosh.

column1: The report contains the combat data of P.M.C. Mangi Security, as well as the engagement situation of the newly released 'Wildhunt' team.
column2: Laporan ini berisi data tempur P.M.C. Mangi Security, serta situasi pertempuran tim 'Wildhunt' yang baru dilepas.

column1: (The young sergeant handed the report to the brigadier general in front of him.)
column2: (Sersan muda itu menyerahkan laporannya kepada brigadir jenderal di hadapannya.)

column1: (Under the bright lights, the silver-haired woman addressed as 'Brigadier General' pondered.)
column2: (Di bawah lampu terang, perempuan berambut perak yang dipanggil 'Brigadir Jenderal' itu termenung.)

column1: The team's attrition rate is 15% higher than expected.
column2: Tingkat kerugian tim itu 15% lebih tinggi dari perkiraan.

column1: Yes, Commodore.
column2: Benar, Komodor.

column1: The encirclement and suppression of Mokosh met with fierce resistance from the other side. The airstrikes we assisted with were intercepted by their air defense system, and the strikes on ground troops also fell short of expectations due to their tactical Doll teams.
column2: Pengepungan dan penumpasan Mokosh mendapat perlawanan sengit dari pihak sana. Serangan udara yang kita bantu dicegat sistem pertahanan udara mereka, dan gempuran ke pasukan darat juga jauh dari harapan karena tim Doll taktis mereka.

column1: Moreover, although lacking actual combat experience, the morale of the opposing ordinary soldiers is very high. The soldiers we captured generally showed extreme emotional reactions during interrogation.
column2: Selain itu, meski minim pengalaman tempur nyata, semangat prajurit biasa pihak lawan sangat tinggi. Prajurit yang kita tangkap umumnya menunjukkan reaksi emosi yang ekstrem saat diinterogasi.

column1: (The silver-haired Commodore listened calmly, seemingly not surprised by her subordinate's report. It wasn't until she saw the part about the "Wildhunt" in the report that she slightly raised an eyebrow.)
column2: (Komodor berambut perak itu mendengarkan dengan tenang, seolah tidak terkejut oleh laporan bawahannya. Baru saat melihat bagian tentang "Wildhunt" di laporan itu, alisnya sedikit terangkat.)

column1: Oh? To think they defeated the "Wildhunt" so quickly.
column2: Oh? Tak kusangka mereka mengalahkan "Wildhunt" secepat itu.

column1: Hehe, I really want to see the expressions of the pigs who bought these weapons at a high price—
column2: Hehe, aku ingin sekali melihat ekspresi para babi yang membeli senjata-senjata ini dengan harga mahal—

column1: Yes, Commodore. The opposing front line initially showed multi-directional routing, but quickly completed adjustments and formed an effective tactical encirclement against the "Wildhunt".
column2: Benar, Komodor. Garis depan lawan awalnya sempat kocar-kacir ke berbagai arah, tapi cepat menyelesaikan penyesuaian dan membentuk kepungan taktis yang efektif terhadap "Wildhunt".

column1: The speed of the opposing side's strategic response far exceeded the enemy's response speed in several recent "Wildhunt" actual combats.
column2: Kecepatan respons strategis pihak lawan jauh melampaui kecepatan respons musuh dalam beberapa pertempuran nyata "Wildhunt" belakangan ini.

column1: They adopted almost all the most effective and deadly tactics against the Wildhunt—even we ourselves didn't know the Wildhunt had these limitations.
column2: Mereka memakai hampir semua taktik paling efektif dan mematikan terhadap Wildhunt—bahkan kita sendiri tidak tahu Wildhunt punya keterbatasan itu.

column1: We speculate that the enemy Commander not only has rich combat experience, but also highly likely has come into contact with intelligence related to the "Wildhunt" or similar units.
column2: Kami menduga Komandan musuh bukan hanya kaya pengalaman tempur, tapi juga sangat mungkin pernah bersinggungan dengan informasi terkait "Wildhunt" atau unit sejenis.

column1: If the enemy Commander is "that person", it is indeed not impossible.
column2: Kalau Komandan musuh itu adalah "orang itu", memang bukan hal yang mustahil.

column1: The "hero" who defected from the URNC, maintaining contact with both Task Force DEFY and Statesec. Huge merits are readily available, yet chooses to protect a crumbling city-state in the Yellow Zone.
column2: Sang "pahlawan" yang membelot dari URNC, menjaga hubungan dengan Task Force DEFY sekaligus Statesec. Jasa besar sudah terhidang di depan mata, tapi dia memilih melindungi negara kota rapuh di Yellow Zone.

column1: And played such a wonderful battle situation with such a clumsy team.
column2: Dan memainkan pertempuran seindah itu dengan pasukan yang secanggung itu.

column1: What an interesting and admirable enemy...
column2: Sungguh musuh yang menarik dan patut dikagumi...

column1: (The silver-haired woman tapped the table, the corners of her lips curling up slightly.)
column2: (Perempuan berambut perak itu mengetuk meja, sudut bibirnya sedikit terangkat.)

column1: (Deep in those always calm eyes, it seemed that at this moment, a spark of fire was ignited.)
column2: (Jauh di dalam mata yang selalu tenang itu, saat ini seolah ada percik api yang menyala.)

column1: Prepare the helicopter, we're going to the front line in two hours.
column2: Siapkan helikopter, kita berangkat ke garis depan dua jam lagi.

column1: Engaging with such an opponent is naturally only interesting face-to-face, isn't it?
column2: Berhadapan dengan lawan seperti itu tentu baru menarik kalau bertatap muka, bukan?

column1: (Hearing my sigh, Vasily also nodded in agreement, frowning as he looked at the material consumption report.)
column2: (Mendengar helaan napasku, Vasily ikut mengangguk setuju, mengerutkan kening menatap laporan konsumsi material.)

column1: (It's just that all reliable entry and exit channels were already inventoried before the war. Is there really one that slipped through the net now...)
column2: (Hanya saja semua jalur keluar-masuk yang bisa diandalkan sudah didata sebelum perang. Apa benar sekarang masih ada yang lolos dari pendataan...)

column1: (Seeing me frown and fall silent, Vasily seemed to remember something, bringing up a map and syncing it to the screen.)
column2: (Melihatku mengerutkan kening dan terdiam, Vasily seperti teringat sesuatu, membuka sebuah peta dan menampilkannya ke layar.)

column1: (No explanation needed, I quickly understood Vasily's intention. This channel, which was abandoned early on due to safety issues, might be able to regain its value in the current situation. Even if it's dangerous, we must try to overcome it.)
column2: (Tanpa perlu penjelasan, aku cepat memahami maksud Vasily. Jalur yang sejak awal ditinggalkan karena masalah keamanan ini mungkin bisa kembali berguna dalam situasi sekarang. Sekalipun berbahaya, kami harus berusaha menaklukkannya.)
